notes.title: Community Feedback Update
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for all the comments (good or bad) from the community! 

We made some adjustments to the gameplay and fixed some bugs according to your comments and feedback. 

We hope to make future games better that you all can enjoy. 

Gameplay 
- We removed the difficult mode and integrated into the main story gameplay. 
- The gameplay difficulties are adjusted to make it more reasonable as a game, but not difficult at the same time. 
- We added a ending message to the game to make the story telling more complete. 

Bugfixes
- Minor bug fixes

If you like this game, please let us know how we can improve on the next game or what language we should make in the future!

Thank you again for everyone who supported and left us comments.

Raging Usagi
